svg.text: A real herd walking an L-shaped lane
Within 10 m of it, aim 5 m into the lane
In the lane, aim 5 m ahead on the path
In the new paddock, head for the centre
max drift; the edge is 4 m
In the lane: aim 5 m ahead
Right emitter fires: she turns left by 0.6·|θ|,
and steers 0.3·θ toward the target by herself.
Only fence cues startle her; guidance never does.
Guidance switches on late and off late
Also by angle: on above 60° off target, off below 30°.
The gap stops a cow on the line from flickering.
